regime_context: The detector shows highly concentrated leadership in Banks (eligible, trend, high breadth but crowded) while the top-ranked Coal theme is NOT absolute-trend eligible and has poor durability/breadth. Rotation breadth is extremely narrow (1/22 eligible), momentum is display-only, and critically the absolute trend gate did_NOT_hold for China A-shares (gate_helps=false) — so the one validated edge (drawdown control) is absent on this market's history, and the backtest explicitly labels this tape mean-reverting. Cross-sectional rank carries no alpha and track record dir_accuracy is weak (0.366).
emerging_watch: Watching Coal (cn_coal) — it leads the momentum rank (score 0.735) but is NOT eligible and has weak durability (0.25) and thin breadth (0.3). It would warrant a fresh look only if it both (a) regains absolute-trend eligibility and (b) breadth rises above ~0.5 on its ETF proxy 515220.SS — otherwise leadership is nominal, not usable.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the ONLY theme passing the absolute-trend eligibility gate, and they combine genuine trend health (hurst_tag=trend), strong breadth (0.833), and high durability (0.8) — the best all-around profile in a tape where almost everything else is either mean-reverting or non-eligible. The lean is a direction on the most structurally intact theme, recognising that in a mean-reverting China market even the eligible trend may whipsaw, and crowding is a cap not a fade.
evidence: eligible=true (only one of 22 themes passing the absolute-trend gate)
theses.dissent: The backtest says the trend gate did_NOT hold for China A-shares — the tape mean-reverts and whipsaws the gate, so eligibility here may be a false positive. Crowding_z=1.77 marks Banks as crowded, and in a mean-reverting market the broad, crowded, fully-priced leader is precisely the theme most vulnerable to a sharp give-back.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS (Banks ETF) fails to exceed CSI 300 by any positive margin over the next 20 trading days, or falls below the CSI 300 on a 10-day rolling basis

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
